## 3. Classifier concurrency limit chosen and why

Limit: _MAX_CONCURRENT_CLASSIFICATIONS = 3, enforced by one module-level
asyncio.Semaphore in watchlist_theme_classifier.py (in-process only; no new
worker/scheduler/queue/Redis/table).

Rationale: bulk-add schedules one asyncio.create_task per genuinely new ticker;
without a bound, N bulk-added tickers fan out into N concurrent DeepSeek calls
plus N concurrent hydration DB reads plus N canonical persistence writes. 3 is
conservative for a single-provider background job on this backend while still
draining a 100-ticker bulk add quickly. Placement covers all expensive
single-ticker execution: metadata-hydration cache reads, the DeepSeek call,
and _persist_classification. Hydration-retry sleeps happen OUTSIDE the
semaphore (waiting tasks hold no resource), the existing per-ticker in-flight
set remains, no ticker is dropped, and the add/bulk-add HTTP response never
awaits the semaphore (tasks are created, not awaited).

## 5. Exact DeepSeek truncation root cause

Live evidence: deepseek-v4-flash returned EMPTY content with
finish_reason='length' — intermittently at max_tokens=1024 AND at 2048, while
identical-size prompts succeeded on other attempts (and a trivial 256-token
probe succeeded). That signature is output-budget exhaustion: the model's
reasoning/thinking tokens consume the max_tokens budget and the visible
content is truncated to empty. It is not a prompt-too-large input failure
and not fixed merely by raising max_tokens.

## 6. Prompt size before/after

Measured with the real assignable registry (23 themes + 67 subthemes = 90 nodes):
  taxonomy section before: 5,598 chars  →  after: 3,963 chars
  full single-ticker prompt before: 7,456 chars (~1,864 est. tokens)
  full single-ticker prompt after:  5,378 chars (~1,344 est. tokens, ~28% smaller)

Changes: one compact `id: display name` line per node (no headings, no
parent references, no per-node metadata), condensed rules to the minimum the
model needs, description truncated to 400 chars (was 600). Output schema
fields unchanged (primary_theme_id, primary_subtheme_id, additional_theme_ids,
confidence, rationale, no_valid_theme). Strict canonical validation
(_validate_taxonomy_result) untouched.

## 7. Exact retry behavior

_call_deepseek_taxonomy: first attempt max_tokens=2048 (compact prompt needs
far less). ONLY when content is empty AND finish_reason=='length' → exactly
ONE retry with max_tokens=4096. Retry still empty → observable failure
(provider_failed + needs_review). All other failures — API errors, empty
content with any other finish_reason, invalid JSON, ticker mismatch — are
observable and NOT retried. No 4-attempt loops, no indefinite retries, no
request-path retries (classifier runs only in background tasks).

  → DO NOT destroy pool\n\nwhile unrelated errors must NOT be misclassified merely because their text\ncontains \"exhausted\".\n\nDo not weaken handling of genuine pool corruption/closed-pool backend/tests/test_pg_pool_exhaustion.py\n\nAdd focused tests proving:\n\n1. implementations.\n\nDo not rely on old architecture assumptions.\n\nFor each of:\n\n    CG\n    RELL\n    ST\n    STDN\n    LODE\n    PCT\n    RRX\n\nand the recent OTC ticker if identifiable, report:\n\n    canonical symbol\n    stored company_name\n    stored sector\n    industry\n    primary theme\n    primary subtheme\n    additional themes\n    taxonomy source/provenance if available\n    classifier status\n    classifier last reason/result\n\nClassifier status must distinguish:\n\n    never scheduled\n    scheduled\n    skipped-existing\n    provider unavailable\n    metadata insufficient\n    llm request failed\n    parse failed\n    confidence rejected\n    no_valid_theme\n    persisted successfully\n    persistence failed\n\nDo not infer \"no_valid_theme\" merely because the UI is blank.\n\n============================================================\nPART A — AUTO-CLASSIFIER RELIABILITY\n============================================================\n\nAudit ALL classifier implementations in:\n\n    services/watchlist_theme_classifier.py\n\nand any route/helper calling it.\n\nThere have historically been BOTH:\n\n- legacy batch Watchlist classification\n- newer single-ticker canonical DeepSeek auto-classification\n\nDetermine which exact path fires when a ticker is newly added TODAY.\n\nIMPORTANT GITHUB REFERENCE TO VERIFY AGAINST LIVE SOURCE:\n\nThe current GitHub classifier file detects:\n\n    provider = deepseek\n    model = deepseek-v4-flash\n\nbut its legacy `_call_llm()` implementation visibly has execution branches for\nGemini and OpenAI and may not have a DeepSeek execution branch.\n\nAlso, the legacy batch classifier excludes `OTC:` symbols from eligible symbols.\n\nDO NOT blindly patch these observations.\n\nFirst determine whether the actual new-add single-ticker path uses those pieces.\n\nThen eliminate architectural split/drift so NEW ADD behavior has one reliable\ncanonical path.\n\nRequired behavior:\n\nWhen a genuinely NEW Watchlist ticker is added and has no existing manual\ntaxonomy:\n\n    add membership commit succeeds immediately\n        →\n    background single-ticker classification scheduled\n        →\n    cached/company metadata hydrated\n        →\n    DeepSeek V4 Flash classification\n        →\n    strict canonical taxonomy validation\n        →\n    atomic canonical taxonomy persistence\n        →\n    appropriate caches invalidated\n\nNO DeepSeek/provider call may block the add-ticker HTTP response.\n\nDo not reclassify existing manual mappings automatically.\n\nDo not force a thematic classification where none exists.\n\nValid result:\n\n    CG\n    sector = Financials\n    theme = null\n    subtheme = null\n    additional themes = []\n\nis completely acceptable.\n\n`no_valid_theme` should be considered a successful classification outcome, not\nan error requiring fake theme assignment.\n\nOTC canonical symbols must remain `OTC:<ticker>` internally.\n\nOnly strip OTC prefix at an existing provider boundary that requires the raw\nprovider ticker.\n\nDo not globally normalize away OTC:.\n\n============================================================\nPART B — COMPANY NAME CORRECTION\n============================================================\n\nDetermine the canonical source of `company_name` in Watchlist detail rows.\n\nFind why:\n\n    STDN -> \"STDN\"\n    LODE -> \"LODE\"\n    PCT  -> \"PCT\"\n    RRX  -> \"RRX\"\n\nare surviving with ticker-as-name.\n\nDistinguish:\n\n1. legitimate company name equals ticker (unlikely)\n2. add payload stored symbol as temporary fallback\n3. metadata cache had no profile at add time\n4. later metadata hydration found a real name but never persisted it\n5. read-layer fallback is masking missing canonical data\n6. some other proven cause\n\nRequired behavior:\n\nA temporary symbol fallback is allowed during the immediate add operation.\n\nBut once cached/FMP/company metadata provides a proper company name, persist the\nproper name to the EXISTING canonical Watchlist/company metadata location.\n\nDo NOT create another company-name cache/store.\n\nDo NOT change provider architecture.\n\nDo NOT add synchronous FMP network calls to the add route.\n\nUse existing cached/profile/fundamentals sources.\n\nWhen classifier metadata hydration already finds:\n\n    companyName\n    sector\n    industry\n\nreuse that information rather than loading duplicate copies.\n\nIf no proper company name is available yet, leave the fallback safely and allow\nexisting future hydration to repair it.\n\n============================================================\nPART C — CANONICAL SECTOR OVERRIDE\n============================================================\n\nCurrent product behavior should be:\n\nNORMAL CASE:\n    provider/FMP sector exists\n        →\n    use it automatically\n\nEXCEPTION:\n    provider sector blank OR user determines sector is wrong\n        →\n    user may explicitly set a canonical manual sector override\n\nManual sector must have precedence over provider-derived sector.\n\nBut absence of a manual sector must continue using FMP/provider sector.\n\nRequired precedence:\n\n    explicit manual sector override\n        >\n    canonical/provider/FMP sector\n        >\n    null\n\nDo NOT copy provider sector into manual override merely because it exists.\n\nManual override is for user intent only.\n\nAudit the existing taxonomy-v2 canonical persistence contract:\n\n    atomic_taxonomy_write_db()\n    theme_ticker_overrides\n    watchlist_category_overrides\n    current taxonomy PUT route/schema\n\nDetermine whether sector_id is already persistable.\n\nIf yes:\n    reuse it.\n\nIf no:\n    extend the EXISTING atomic taxonomy write contract minimally.\n\nDo NOT create:\n\n    new sector endpoint\n    new override table\n    new JSON store\n    parallel taxonomy service\n\nThe same taxonomy save operation that persists:\n\n    primary theme\n    subtheme\n    additional themes\n\nmust be capable of persisting an explicit sector override atomically.\n\nClearing a manual sector override must restore provider/FMP sector behavior.\n\n============================================================\nREAD CONTRACT\n============================================================\n\nWatchlist responses must expose enough information for frontend to distinguish:\n\n    effective sector\n    provider/FMP sector\n    manual sector override\n\nPrefer using existing provenance fields if available.\n\nDo not duplicate fields unnecessarily.\n\nAt minimum the frontend must be able to:\n\n- display effective sector\n- know whether sector was manually overridden\n- edit/clear that override\n\n============================================================\nBACKFILL / CURRENT BROKEN ROWS\n============================================================\n\nDo NOT bulk reclassify the whole Watchlist.\n\nAfter implementation, surgically test the recent broken examples.\n\nFor company names:\nrepair recent ticker-as-name records where proper cached metadata already exists.\n\nFor theme assignment:\nrun the canonical single-ticker classifier against ONLY the recent unassigned\nnew tickers that have never successfully completed classification.\n\nDo not overwrite manual mappings.\n\nFor CG:\nif the canonical/FMP sector is genuinely blank, do NOT invent a backend manual\nsector without user action merely to make the UI look complete.\n\nWe will validate the new sector editor from the frontend.\n\n============================================================\nTESTS\n============================================================\n\nAdd focused regression coverage for:\n\n1. new ticker schedules classifier after membership commit\n2. add HTTP response does not wait for DeepSeek\n3. DeepSeek V4 Flash execution path actually executes\n4. DeepSeek provider error is observable, not silently converted into blank theme\n5. no_valid_theme persists/records successful no-theme outcome\n6. OTC ticker can use single-ticker classifier\n7. existing manual taxonomy is never overwritten\n8. company_name symbol fallback is repairable from cached metadata\n9. proper company name is not overwritten by ticker\n10. FMP sector remains default when no manual override\n11. manual sector override wins over FMP sector\n12. clearing manual sector restores FMP sector\n13. atomic taxonomy save includes sector without breaking theme/subtheme/additional\n14. taxonomy cache/BULK_LKG invalidation still occurs\n\nRun existing taxonomy tests too.\n\n============================================================\nSCOPE GUARD\n============================================================\n\nExpected production files should remain tightly scoped to existing:\n\n- Watchlist add route/service\n- watchlist theme classifier\n- canonical taxonomy persistence/schema if required\n\nDo not touch unrelated Home latency, DB pool, earnings, options, auth, news, etc.\n\nIf this requires a new architectural store or endpoint:\n\nSTOP.\n\nThat means the existing path has not been understood.\n\n============================================================\nDELIVERY\n============================================================\n\nAfter implementation:\n\n- focused tests\n- existing taxonomy suite\n- build\n- workspace guard prepush\n- exact-stage only intended source/tests\n- one focused commit\n- push origin/main using working gh/Replit credential path\n- DO NOT PUBLISH\n\nFinal report:\n\n1. proven cause of inconsistent DeepSeek assignment\n2. exact classifier path used on new-add before/after\n3. status for each recent ticker\n4. proven cause of ticker-as-company-name\n5. records repaired\n6. current canonical sector architecture\n7. exact sector override implementation\n8. files changed\n9. tests\n10. commit SHA\n11. push result\n12. final HEAD/origin\n13. git status\n14.  _MAX_HYDRATE_ATTEMPTS = 10
 _HYDRATE_RETRY_DELAY  = 20.0
 
+# ── Bounded classifier concurrency ───────────────────────────────────────────
+# Bulk-add schedules one background task per new ticker.  Without a bound,
+# 100 bulk-added tickers would fan out into 100 concurrent DeepSeek calls,
+# hydration DB reads and canonical writes.  This in-process semaphore bounds
+# the expensive single-ticker classification execution (metadata hydration
+# reads, the DeepSeek call, and canonical persistence) to a small, safe number
+# while the HTTP add response never awaits it.  Sleeps between hydration
+# retries happen OUTSIDE the semaphore so waiting tasks hold no resource.
+_MAX_CONCURRENT_CLASSIFICATIONS = 3
+_CLASSIFY_SEMAPHORE: asyncio.Semaphore | None = None
+
+
+def _get_classify_semaphore() -> asyncio.Semaphore:
+    global _CLASSIFY_SEMAPHORE
+    if _CLASSIFY_SEMAPHORE is None:
+        _CLASSIFY_SEMAPHORE = asyncio.Semaphore(_MAX_CONCURRENT_CLASSIFICATIONS)
+    return _CLASSIFY_SEMAPHORE
+
 # ── Per-ticker single-ticker classifier observability ────────────────────────
 # In-memory only: records when a ticker was scheduled and its latest result so
 # status queries can distinguish never_scheduled / scheduled / provider_failed /

--- a/backend/tests/test_watchlist_ticker_identity.py
+++ b/backend/tests/test_watchlist_ticker_identity.py
@@ -24,6 +24,22 @@ Covers three connected defects in the newly-added Watchlist ticker lifecycle:
          theme/subtheme/additional theme writes
        - taxonomy cache + BULK LKG invalidation still occurs after writes
 
+  D. Bounded classifier concurrency (bulk-add fanout protection)
+       - bulk add still returns before classifiers finish
+       - every genuinely new ticker is eventually scheduled
+       - concurrent classification execution never exceeds the configured limit
+       - single-ticker behavior unchanged
+       - manual assignments still skip classification
+
+  E. DeepSeek length-truncation handling
+       - normal response → exactly one call
+       - explicit length truncation → exactly one bounded retry
+       - retry succeeds → classification proceeds
+       - retry also truncates → provider_failed (observable)
+       - arbitrary API errors do not loop
+       - invalid JSON remains observable, not retried
+       - no_valid_theme remains a successful outcome
+
 Run:
     cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_watchlist_ticker_identity.py -v
 """
@@ -955,3 +971,294 @@ class TestPersistClassificationInvalidation:
         assert ok is True

+
+
+# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+# D — Bounded classifier concurrency (bulk-add fanout protection)
+# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+
+class TestClassifierConcurrencyBound:
+    def _mock_add_deps(self, monkeypatch):
+        monkeypatch.setattr("data.pg_storage.watchlist_add_ticker",
+                            lambda wl, t, family_aliases=None: {"added": True, "ticker_count": 1})
+        monkeypatch.setattr("data.pg_storage.is_available", lambda: True)
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.canonical_security_adapter.exchange_family_aliases",
+                            lambda t: [])
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.user_earnings_service.invalidate_user_earnings",
+                            lambda u: None)
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.watchlist_quote_cache.is_fmp_symbol_eligible",
+                            lambda t: False)
+
+        async def _fake_priority(syms, wl_id):
+            return None
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.watchlist_router._priority_hydrate_symbols",
+                            _fake_priority)
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_bulk_add_returns_before_classifiers_finish(self, monkeypatch):
+        import services.watchlist_router as wr
+
+        self._mock_add_deps(monkeypatch)
+        release = asyncio.Event()
+        started: list[str] = []
+        done: list[str] = []
+
+        async def _slow_classify(ticker, *a, **k):
+            started.append(ticker)
+            await release.wait()
+            done.append(ticker)
+            return {"action": "classified"}
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.watchlist_theme_classifier.classify_and_assign_ticker",
+                            _slow_classify)
+
+        body = wr._BulkAddBody(tickers=["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"])
+        resp = await asyncio.wait_for(
+            wr.bulk_add_tickers_endpoint("wl-bulk", body), timeout=5.0,
+        )
+        assert resp["success"] is True
+        assert not done, "bulk-add HTTP response must NOT wait for classifiers"
+        assert started, "classifier tasks should have started in the background"
+        release.set()  # cleanup
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_all_bulk_added_tickers_eventually_classified(self, monkeypatch):
+        import services.watchlist_router as wr
+
+        self._mock_add_deps(monkeypatch)
+        classified: list[str] = []
+
+        async def _fake_classify(ticker, *a, **k):
+            classified.append(ticker)
+            return {"action": "classified"}
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.watchlist_theme_classifier.classify_and_assign_ticker",
+                            _fake_classify)
+
+        tickers = [f"BLK{i}" for i in range(12)]
+        body = wr._BulkAddBody(tickers=tickers)
+        resp = await asyncio.wait_for(
+            wr.bulk_add_tickers_endpoint("wl-bulk", body), timeout=5.0,
+        )
+        assert resp["success"] is True
+        for _ in range(50):
+            if len(classified) == len(tickers):
+                break
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+        assert sorted(classified) == sorted(tickers), (
+            "every genuinely-new bulk-added ticker must be scheduled — none dropped"
+        )
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_concurrent_execution_never_exceeds_limit(self, monkeypatch):
+        import re
+        import threading
+        import services.watchlist_theme_classifier as wc
+
+        active = 0
+        peak = 0
+        lock = threading.Lock()
+        calls = 0
+
+        async def _fake_deepseek(prompt, model_name):
+            nonlocal active, peak, calls
+            _m = re.search(r"TICKER: (\S+)", prompt)
+            _sym = _m.group(1) if _m else "CONC"
+            with lock:
+                active += 1
+                peak = max(peak, active)
+                calls += 1
+            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
+            with lock:
+                active -= 1
+            return {
+                "ticker": _sym,
+                "company_name": f"Concurrent Co {_sym}",
+                "primary_theme_id": "semiconductors",
+                "primary_subtheme_id": None,
+                "additional_theme_ids": [],
+                "confidence": 0.9,
+                "rationale": "test",
+                "no_valid_theme": False,
+            }
+
+        async def _fake_persist(validated):
+            return True
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(wc, "_call_deepseek_taxonomy", _fake_deepseek)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(wc, "_persist_classification", _fake_persist)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(wc, "mark_needs_review", lambda syms, reason="": None)
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.category_overrides.get_overrides",
+                            lambda uid="default": {})
+        monkeypatch.setattr("data.pg_storage.get_theme_ticker_overrides",
+                            lambda theme_id=None: [])
+
+        tickers = [f"CONC{i}" for i in range(9)]
+        results = await asyncio.gather(*[
+            wc.classify_and_assign_ticker(
+                t, f"Concurrent Co {t}", _LONG_DESC, "Technology",
+                hydrate_attempts=0, hydrate_delay=0.0,
+            )
+            for t in tickers
+        ])
+        assert calls == 9, "every scheduled classification must execute"
+        assert peak <= wc._MAX_CONCURRENT_CLASSIFICATIONS, (
+            f"concurrent DeepSeek executions must never exceed the bound; peak={peak}"
+        )
+        assert peak == wc._MAX_CONCURRENT_CLASSIFICATIONS, (
+            "with 9 contenders the bound should be reached exactly (3)"
+        )
+        assert all(r["action"] == "classified" for r in results), results
+
+    def test_semaphore_limit_is_conservative(self):
+        import services.watchlist_theme_classifier as wc
+        assert wc._MAX_CONCURRENT_CLASSIFICATIONS == 3, (
+            "default bound must remain max 3 concurrent DeepSeek executions"
+        )
+
+
+# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+# E — DeepSeek length-truncation handling (one bounded retry)
+# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+
+class TestDeepSeekLengthTruncation:
+    @staticmethod
+    def _resp(content: str, finish: str):
+        choice = MagicMock()
+        choice.message.content = content
+        choice.finish_reason = finish
+        resp = MagicMock()
+        resp.choices = [choice]
+        return resp
+
+    def _mock_openai(self, monkeypatch, side_effects):
+        """side_effects: list of (content, finish) tuples or exceptions."""
+        fake_client = MagicMock()
+
+        def _create(**kwargs):
+            effect = side_effects.pop(0)
+            if isinstance(effect, Exception):
+                raise effect
+            content, finish = effect
+            return self._resp(content, finish)
+
+        fake_client.chat.completions.create.side_effect = _create
+        monkeypatch.setattr("openai.OpenAI", lambda *a, **k: fake_client)
+        monkeypatch.setenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "test-key")
+        return fake_client
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_normal_response_single_call(self, monkeypatch):
+        wc = _get_classifier()
+        client = self._mock_openai(monkeypatch, [
+            ('{"classifications": []}', "stop"),
+        ])
+        result = await wc._call_deepseek_taxonomy("prompt", "deepseek-v4-flash")
+        assert result == {"classifications": []}
+        assert client.chat.completions.create.call_count == 1, "no retry on normal response"
+        assert client.chat.completions.create.call_args.kwargs["max_tokens"] == 2048
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_length_truncation_triggers_exactly_one_retry(self, monkeypatch):
+        wc = _get_classifier()
+        client = self._mock_openai(monkeypatch, [
+            ("", "length"),                                    # truncated first attempt
+            ('{"classifications": []}', "stop"),                # retry succeeds
+        ])
+        result = await wc._call_deepseek_taxonomy("prompt", "deepseek-v4-flash")
+        assert result == {"classifications": []}
+        assert client.chat.completions.create.call_count == 2, "exactly one bounded retry"
+        max_tokens = [c.kwargs["max_tokens"]
+                      for c in client.chat.completions.create.call_args_list]
+        assert max_tokens == [2048, 4096], (
+            "retry must use the larger budget, not an unbounded loop"
+        )
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_retry_success_classification_proceeds(self, monkeypatch):
+        import services.watchlist_theme_classifier as wc
+        import json as _json
+
+        valid_payload = _json.dumps({
+            "ticker": "NVDA",
+            "company_name": "NVIDIA Corp",
+            "primary_theme_id": "semiconductors",
+            "primary_subtheme_id": None,
+            "additional_theme_ids": [],
+            "confidence": 0.95,
+            "rationale": "accelerators",
+            "no_valid_theme": False,
+        })
+        self._mock_openai(monkeypatch, [("", "length"), (valid_payload, "stop")])
+
+        async def _fake_persist(validated):
+            return True
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(wc, "_persist_classification", _fake_persist)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(wc, "mark_needs_review", lambda syms, reason="": None)
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.category_overrides.get_overrides",
+                            lambda uid="default": {})
+        monkeypatch.setattr("data.pg_storage.get_theme_ticker_overrides",
+                            lambda theme_id=None: [])
+
+        result = await wc.classify_and_assign_ticker(
+            "NVDA", "NVIDIA Corp", _LONG_DESC, "Technology",
+            hydrate_attempts=0, hydrate_delay=0.0,
+        )
+        assert result["action"] == "classified", result
+        assert result["primary_theme_id"] == "semiconductors"
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_retry_also_truncates_is_provider_failed(self, monkeypatch):
+        import services.watchlist_theme_classifier as wc
+
+        client = self._mock_openai(monkeypatch, [("", "length"), ("", "length")])
+        needs_review: list = []
+        monkeypatch.setattr(wc, "mark_needs_review",
+                            lambda syms, reason="": needs_review.append((syms, reason)))
+        monkeypatch.setattr("services.category_overrides.get_overrides",
+                            lambda uid="default": {})
+        monkeypatch.setattr("data.pg_storage.get_theme_ticker_overrides",
+                            lambda theme_id=None: [])
+
+        result = await wc.classify_and_assign_ticker(
+            "NVDA", "NVIDIA Corp", _LONG_DESC, "Technology",
+            hydrate_attempts=0, hydrate_delay=0.0,
+        )
+        assert result["action"] == "provider_failed", result
+        assert result["error"]
+        assert client.chat.completions.create.call_count == 2, (
+            "exactly two provider calls — no unbounded retry loop"
+        )
+        assert needs_review == [(["NVDA"], "deepseek_api_failure")]
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_api_error_does_not_loop(self, monkeypatch):
+        wc = _get_classifier()
+        client = self._mock_openai(monkeypatch, [Exception("api down")])
+        result = await wc._call_deepseek_taxonomy("prompt", "deepseek-v4-flash")
+        assert result is None
+        assert client.chat.completions.create.call_count == 1, (
+            "arbitrary API errors must not be retried"
+        )
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_invalid_json_observable_not_retried(self, monkeypatch):
+        wc = _get_classifier()
+        client = self._mock_openai(monkeypatch, [("not valid json at all", "stop")])
+        result = await wc._call_deepseek_taxonomy("prompt", "deepseek-v4-flash")
+        assert result is None, "invalid JSON remains an observable provider failure"
+        assert client.chat.completions.create.call_count == 1, (
+            "invalid JSON must not trigger the length-truncation retry"
+        )
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_empty_content_non_length_not_retried(self, monkeypatch):
+        wc = _get_classifier()
+        client = self._mock_openai(monkeypatch, [("", "stop")])
+        result = await wc._call_deepseek_taxonomy("prompt", "deepseek-v4-flash")
